rows.grounds: fused form of bhavet and pītam

items.question: Which ritual substance is remembered as white and rice-born while night-dust becomes yellow?
items.inference: The verse assigns yellow to night-dust and white rice-born status to the remembered substance.
uncertainties: exact ritual referent of night-dust is not specified in this verse
items.plain_english: Night-dust becomes yellow; white is remembered as rice-born.
